spec.title: TDS
spec.description: Displays the last known TDS value in ppm for the specific device selected within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  time,
  NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric AS value
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND id = '$id'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

spec.title: Top 10 TDS Logs
spec.description: Displays the top 10 highest TDS measurements and their exact timestamps recorded by the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds')::numeric DESC) AS "#",
  t.time AS "Measurement Time",
  (t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds')::numeric AS "TDS"
FROM device_telemetry t
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.time)
  AND t.id = '$id'
  AND t.metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "TDS" DESC
LIMIT 10;

spec.title: Location
spec.description: Node location based on registered data, color represents node's status.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.latitude AS "latitude",
  d.longitude AS "longitude",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0 
    WHEN t.time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END AS "Status",
  t.time AS "Last Seen"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sub.time
  FROM device_telemetry sub
  WHERE sub.id = d.id
  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true
WHERE d.id = '$id';

  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0

  END AS "Status",

FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sub.time
  FROM device_telemetry sub
  WHERE sub.id = d.id
  ORDER BY sub.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON true
WHERE d.id = '$id';
